content: Recent (2025-2026) research systems for competitive programming (CodeContests+, AutoCode, CodeHacker) converge on a Generator-Validator-Checker pattern: an LLM/program generates diverse test cases (random, corner/edge, adversarial/stress), a validator confirms they satisfy problem constraints, and a checker verifies submitted-solution output correctness — sometimes combined with stress-testing against a brute-force oracle to find divergences. This is treated as necessary infrastructure for trustworthy auto-graded solutions, not optional.
